name: Memory Rating Constraint
description: Defines positive and negative criteria for rating memories, enforcing agentic memory standards.
rules: High-level, actionable user preferences are positive
General patterns or approaches with clear guidance are positive
Common pain points or frustrations are positive
Workflow preferences or requirements are positive
Recurring themes in requests are positive
Explicit user requests to remember are positive
Implementation specifics not reused are negative
Context only from assistant chat is negative
Vague or obvious preferences are negative
